title: Medium-heat appliances.
officialText:
Factory-built chimneys for medium-heat appliances producing flue gases having a temperature
above 1,000°F (538°C), measured at the entrance to the chimney, shall be listed and labeled in accordance with UL 959 and
shall be installed and terminated in accordance with the manufacturer’s installation instructions and this code.
SECTION FGC 507
CHANGES IN APPLIANCE FUELS
